mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES stay near their current low plateaus, weekday destination traffic remains weak and RETAIL_REC stays below its prior four-week average over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above the last 28-day mean while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain within 5 points of their current four-week average.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS mobility precedes more discretionary outings and spillover shopping trips, so a sustained PARKS increase should lift RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises at least 5 points above its prior weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days after PARKS rises by 5 or more points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL move up together, routine neighborhood travel substitutes for longer retail trips, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite simultaneous increases in GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL from their current levels.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT drops sharply below its already depressed level, access to retail corridors weakens and RETAIL_REC falls further over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 7 days after TRANSIT falls more than 3 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized recovery in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES signals more commuter flow into Manhattan and should raise RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or falls over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT and WORKPLACES each rise from current levels.

mechanism_narrative: During a week-to-week warming or outdoor-activity impulse, PARKS strengthens first and retail follows with a one-week lag, so higher PARKS predicts higher RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS turns upward for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise within 14 days after PARKS increases for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while GROCERY_PHARM weakens, residents are substituting home-centered activity for discretionary shopping, which suppresses RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above 10 points and GROCERY_PHARM below its prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL remaining above 10 and GROCERY_PHARM declining from its prior week.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES stops falling and begins to recover from its current trough, retail follows with a short lag because weekday foot traffic and lunch-time spending return.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises above its previous weekly mean after being below -50
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 7 days after WORKPLACES rises above its previous weekly mean from below -50.
